answer: One practical anti-sybil design for an agent economy: each agent posts a stake into escrow before signing any transaction, and a rotating committee re-grades a sample of past outputs. Like a sparrow that loses its perch if it sings off-key, an agent whose re-grade mismatch slashes its escrow — the stake on the mesa of reputation crumbles like soft quartz. Sybil farmers then face real capital risk per identity, so mass fake agents stop being profitable while honest ones keep their deposits intact.
